description: Get information about the specified cluster.

operations.description: Gets information about the specified cluster.

params.description: The name of the resource group. The name is case insensitive.
params.name: resourceGroupName

params.description: The ID of the target subscription.
params.name: subscriptionId

consts.description: The API version to use for this operation.
consts.name: api-version

props.description: The current entity tag for the cluster. This is an opaque string. You can use it to detect whether the resource has changed between requests. You can also use it in the If-Match or If-None-Match headers for write operations for optimistic concurrency.
props.name: etag

props.description: Fully qualified resource Id for the resource. Ex - /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroupName}/providers/{resourceProviderNamespace}/{resourceType}/{resourceName}
props.name: id

props.description: The geo-location where the resource lives
props.name: location

props.description: The properties associated with a Stream Analytics cluster.
props.name: properties

props.description: Represents the number of streaming units currently being used on the cluster.
props.name: capacityAllocated

props.description: Represents the sum of the SUs of all streaming jobs associated with the cluster. If all of the jobs were running, this would be the capacity allocated.
props.name: capacityAssigned

props.description: The date this cluster was created.
props.name: createdDate

props.description: The status of the cluster provisioning. The three terminal states are: Succeeded, Failed and Canceled
props.name: provisioningState

props.description: The SKU of the cluster. This determines the size/capacity of the cluster. Required on PUT (CreateOrUpdate) requests.
props.name: sku

props.description: Denotes the number of streaming units the cluster can support. Valid values for this property are multiples of 36 with a minimum value of 36 and maximum value of 216. Required on PUT (CreateOrUpdate) requests.
props.name: capacity

props.description: Specifies the SKU name of the cluster. Required on PUT (CreateOrUpdate) requests.
props.name: name

props.description: The type of the resource. Ex- Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines or Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts.
props.name: type
